get_raw_dataset: load a raw Hugging Face dataset with optional cache directory and streaming mode
get_custom_datasets_from_path: build a dictionary of custom dataset file paths from a directory containing json files
transform_dataset_keys: rename dataset dict keys to train, val, or test when a unique match exists
create_raw_dataset: create a raw dataset from Hugging Face using dataset_args with cache_dir and streaming options
test_custom_datasets: test the custom dataset discovery from a directory structure with json files
